objective: Implement idempotency check before charge dispatch.

context.content: Idempotency requirements: check Redis key `idemp:{key}` with SET NX EX 120; if exists return cached response; otherwise execute charge.

interface: Define process_payment(idempotency_key, amount). Provided globals: redis has .get(key), .set(key,value,nx=False,ex=None); stripe.Charge.create(amount=...) returns a JSON-compatible receipt. Return that receipt or the cached receipt.
